notes: Canonical financial-statement line items (QNT-021). Versioned repository content: a canonical row is traceable to raw payload plus this version, so a mapping correction is distinguishable from a provider data change. Deliberately small — forty precise items beat three hundred half-understood ones; add an item when a factor needs it, and bump the version when any entry's meaning changes. Names are British English (amortisation, not amortization); provider spellings are the mapping files' problem, not the taxonomy's. Sign conventions: 'positive' means the item is carried as a positive magnitude even where it is economically a cost (cost_of_sales, total_liabilities) — it is subtracted by whoever uses it, never added; 'negative' means a cash outflow is carried negative (capital_expenditure, dividends_paid, share_buybacks), which is the convention that makes free_cash_flow = operating_cash_flow + capital_expenditure a sum; 'either' means the sign is genuinely informative (a loss, negative equity, negative free cash flow). A provider disagreeing with the convention is corrected by the mapping entry's sign flag, never by code. Derived ratios and factor definitions are Epic 8 and are deliberately absent.

items.name: revenue
items.definition: Turnover from ordinary activities for the period, net of sales taxes and trade discounts.

items.name: cost_of_sales
items.definition: Costs directly attributable to revenue, as a positive magnitude; consumers subtract it.

items.name: gross_profit
items.definition: Revenue less cost of sales, as reported; negative for a gross loss.

items.name: operating_profit
items.definition: Profit from operations before interest and tax (EBIT), as reported by the company.

items.name: pre_tax_profit
items.definition: Profit before taxation, after net finance costs and associates.

items.name: net_income
items.definition: Profit for the period attributable to ordinary shareholders, after tax and minority interests.

items.name: eps_basic
items.definition: Basic earnings per share as reported: reporting currency per share, not a total.

items.name: eps_diluted
items.definition: Diluted earnings per share as reported, on the company's own dilution basis.

items.name: weighted_average_shares_basic
items.definition: Weighted average ordinary shares used as the denominator of basic EPS. A count, never converted by an FX rate.

items.name: total_assets
items.definition: Total assets at period end, current plus non-current.

items.name: total_liabilities
items.definition: Total liabilities at period end as a positive magnitude, current plus non-current.

items.name: total_equity
items.definition: Total shareholders' equity including minority interests; genuinely negative for some leveraged issuers.

items.name: total_debt
items.definition: Interest-bearing borrowings, short and long term, as a positive magnitude. Excludes trade payables; lease liabilities are included only where the provider includes them, which differs pre/post IFRS 16 — check the mapping's review status before using this in a leverage factor.

items.name: cash_and_equivalents
items.definition: Cash and cash equivalents at period end, excluding restricted cash where the provider distinguishes it.

items.name: shares_outstanding
items.definition: Ordinary shares in issue at period end, excluding treasury shares. A count, never converted by an FX rate.

items.name: operating_cash_flow
items.definition: Net cash generated from operating activities, after tax and interest where the company presents them there.

items.name: capital_expenditure
items.definition: Purchases of property, plant, equipment and intangibles, as a cash OUTFLOW and therefore negative. Providers that report a positive magnitude must carry sign 'flip' in their mapping entry.

items.name: free_cash_flow
items.definition: Operating cash flow plus capital expenditure (capex being negative, so this is a sum). Mapped from the provider's own figure where it publishes one; deriving it is Epic 8's job, not the mapper's.

items.name: dividends_paid
items.definition: Cash dividends paid to ordinary shareholders during the period, as an outflow and therefore negative.

items.name: share_buybacks
items.definition: Cash spent repurchasing the company's own shares, as an outflow and therefore negative. Net of issuance only where the provider reports it net, which the mapping's review status must state.

items.name: depreciation_amortisation
items.definition: Depreciation and amortisation charged in the period, as the positive add-back appearing in the cash flow statement.
